title: vuln_mosaic settings
description: Operator choices for the vuln_mosaic collector. Lives at <home>/settings.json on the operator's filesystem; never read from the grid (req-vuln-mosaic-settings).

sources.description: Per-source switches, keyed by source name. A source not listed keeps its default.

cvelist.description: CVE Record v5 records from the CVE Program's cvelistV5 repository.

enabled.description: Whether the refresh fetches this source. Default true.

max_age_days.description: A dataset checked longer ago than this is stale. Default 3.

mode.description: wanted (default) holds only the ids consumers ask for; full holds every record (about 0.7 GB).

kev.description: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, held as one file.

enabled.description: Whether the refresh fetches this source. Default true.

max_age_days.description: A dataset checked longer ago than this is stale. Default 3.

epss.description: The FIRST EPSS daily scores, held as one file.

enabled.description: Whether the refresh fetches this source. Default true.

max_age_days.description: A dataset checked longer ago than this is stale. Default 3.

nvd.description: NVD API 2.0 records for the wanted ids. Off by default.

enabled.description: Whether the refresh fetches this source. Default false.

max_age_days.description: A dataset checked longer ago than this is stale. Default 3.

osv.description: OSV advisories, one whole zip per ecosystem. Off by default; large (Wolfi 300 MB, Chainguard 1.07 GB, Ubuntu 777 MB), and every enabled ecosystem costs about twice its zip on disk because two builds are kept.

enabled.description: Whether the refresh fetches this source. Default false.

max_age_days.description: A dataset checked longer ago than this is stale. Default 3.

ecosystems.description: Ecosystem names to hold, each of which must also appear in the bucket's ecosystems.txt. A name becomes a directory name, so it is restricted here.

ghsa.description: GitHub Security Advisories (the advisory-database repository), for the wanted GHSA ids. Off by default; the first fetch downloads about 48 MB of tree data, and advisories are read only for the ids consumers ask for. Egress host: github.com.

enabled.description: Whether the refresh fetches this source. Default false.

max_age_days.description: A dataset checked longer ago than this is stale. Default 3.

immediate_fetch.description: When true, a read that misses fetches the record inside the call (10 s budget) instead of only queueing it. Default false.

mirror.description: Per-source directory holding an operator-supplied artifact and its manifest.json. A source with a mirror makes no network connection (req-vuln-mosaic-mirror).

cvelist.description: Directory holding a git bundle and manifest.json.

kev.description: Directory holding the catalog file and manifest.json.

epss.description: Directory holding the scores file and manifest.json.

nvd.description: Directory holding a JSON export of the stored records and manifest.json.

osv.description: Directory holding one zip per ecosystem, each with its manifest.
